SQL: CREATE TABLE SummaryGroup (GroupID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, GroupGuid TEXT(38) NOT NULL, Title TEXT(120) NOT NULL, FormKind TEXT(12) NOT NULL, Paygrade TEXT(5) NOT NULL, KeySpec LONGTEXT, VersionCounter LONG, IsArchived BIT)
CREATE TABLE GroupMember (MemberID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, GroupID LONG NOT NULL, ReportID LONG NOT NULL, Paygrade TEXT(5) NOT NULL, ExceptionReason LONGTEXT)
CREATE TABLE GroupSnapshot (SnapshotID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, GroupID LONG NOT NULL, Stamp LONGTEXT, AttestedBy LONG NOT NULL, AttestedAt DATETIME, CompletenessNote LONGTEXT)
CREATE TABLE GroupSnapshotMember (SnapshotMemberID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, SnapshotID LONG NOT NULL, ReportID LONG NOT NULL, RevisionID LONG NOT NULL, Promotion TEXT(20), TraitAverage DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE FieldDefault (DefaultID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, ScopeKind TEXT(12) NOT NULL, ScopeID LONG NOT NULL, FieldKey TEXT(64) NOT NULL, ValueText LONGTEXT, IsNullValue BIT, VersionCounter LONG)
CREATE TABLE ChangeBatch (BatchID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, BatchGuid TEXT(38) NOT NULL, BatchKind TEXT(30), BatchState TEXT(20), AuthorID LONG NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME, BatchNote LONGTEXT)

CREATE TABLE ChangeItem (ItemID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, BatchID LONG NOT NULL, ReportID LONG NOT NULL, ExpectedRevision LONG NOT NULL, FieldKey TEXT(64) NOT NULL, NewValue LONGTEXT, NewIsNull BIT, BeforeValue LONGTEXT, BeforeIsNull BIT, AppliedRevision LONG)
CREATE TABLE RouteTemplate (TemplateID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, Title TEXT(120), IsArchived BIT)
CREATE TABLE RouteTemplateStep (TemplateStepID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, TemplateID LONG NOT NULL, StepOrdinal LONG NOT NULL, AssigneeID LONG NOT NULL, Instructions LONGTEXT)

CREATE TABLE RouteRun (RunID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, ReportID LONG NOT NULL, RevisionID LONG NOT NULL, TemplateID LONG NOT NULL, CurrentStep LONG, RunState TEXT(20), GroupID LONG, GroupStamp LONGTEXT, RequestedBy LONG NOT NULL, RequestedAt DATETIME, ApprovedBy LONG, ApprovedAt DATETIME)

CREATE TABLE RouteRunStep (RunStepID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, RunID LONG NOT NULL, StepOrdinal LONG NOT NULL, AssigneeID LONG NOT NULL, Instructions LONGTEXT, StepState TEXT(20), DecisionNote LONGTEXT, DecisionAt DATETIME)
CREATE TABLE ComparisonSet (SetID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, GroupSnapshotID LONG NOT NULL, Title TEXT(120), CreatedBy LONG NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME)
CREATE TABLE ComparisonMember (ComparisonMemberID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, SetID LONG NOT NULL, ReportID LONG NOT NULL, RevisionID LONG NOT NULL, SortOrdinal LONG)

CREATE TABLE MeetingProposal (ProposalID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, SetID LONG NOT NULL, ReportID LONG NOT NULL, BaseRevision LONG NOT NULL, FieldKey TEXT(64), ValueText LONGTEXT, IsNullValue BIT, ProposalState TEXT(20), AppliedRevision LONG)
CREATE TABLE RulePack (PackID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, VersionName TEXT(120), SourceTitle TEXT(200), SourceURL LONGTEXT, SourceSHA256 TEXT(64), EffectiveFrom DATETIME, EffectiveTo DATETIME)

CREATE TABLE RuleDefinition (RuleID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, PackID LONG NOT NULL, RuleCode TEXT(64), FieldKey TEXT(64), CheckKind TEXT(30), ExpectedValue LONGTEXT, FormKind TEXT(12), Severity TEXT(20), SourceLocator TEXT(120), Description LONGTEXT)
CREATE TABLE ValidationRun (ValidationRunID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, ReportID LONG NOT NULL, RevisionID LONG NOT NULL, PackID LONG NOT NULL, RunAt DATETIME, GroupSnapshotID LONG)
CREATE TABLE ValidationFinding (FindingID COUNTER PRIMARY KEY, ValidationRunID LONG NOT NULL, RuleID LONG, FindingState TEXT(20), Message LONGTEXT)
